title: The ste-lint action's run.sh keeps its exit codes: set -e is checked, and fail: false no longer mutes UNKNOWN
why: Coordinator 12:37 CST Nov 8, from lane unknown-read-one-rule round 3. It named a follow-up step that checks run.sh's `set -e`; triage found none on the roadmap, so this step holds it. Two more gaps: actions/ste-lint/run.sh:140 sets STALE_EXIT=0 when FAIL is not true, which also mutes stale_cites' UNKNOWN; actions/ste-lint/action.yml:14 still says "'false' never fails".
